p2aWeakness: the P2-A per-invocation tracker holds two slots (sessionId + conflictingSessionId), so a THIRD distinct identity for one invocation is lost (F6)
p2bModel: one durable record per distinct (projectId, attemptId, invocationId, dshSessionId); conflict is a PROJECTION over the complete accepted observation set
properties: an observation is never discarded merely because it differs from an earlier one
a conflicting Invocation yields no unique verified SessionId
conflicts remain conflicts after a restart
